## Summary function

```{r}
# Define function to use when summarizing data
summarySE <- function(data = NULL,
                      measurevar,
                      groupvars = NULL,
                      na.rm = FALSE,
                      conf.interval = .95,
                      .drop = TRUE) {
  length2 <- function (x, na.rm = FALSE) {
    if (na.rm) sum(!is.na(x))
    else       length(x)
  }
  
  datac <- ddply(data, groupvars, .drop =.drop,
                 .fun = function(xx, col) {
                   c(N    = length2(xx[[col]], na.rm = na.rm),
                     mean = mean   (xx[[col]], na.rm = na.rm),
                     sd   = sd     (xx[[col]], na.rm = na.rm)
                   )
                 },
                 measurevar
  )
  
  datac <- plyr::rename(datac, c("mean" = measurevar))
  
  datac$se <- datac$sd / sqrt(datac$N)
  
  ciMult <- qt(conf.interval/2 + .5, datac$N-1)
  datac$ci <- datac$se * ciMult
  
  return(datac)
}
```

#### Plot: Bocas weather station daily mean

##### Make data

```{r}
# Daily mean

                        groupvars = c("Year",

                                      "Day"),
```

#### Plot: DHWs

##### Calcuate DHWs

```{r}
# First, calculate "hotspot" for each day; this is the temperature above the bleaching threshold (here, 29.45°C)
bwsdaymean$Hotspot <- ifelse(bwsdaymean$Temperature_C > 29.46,
                             bwsdaymean$Temperature_C-29.46,
                             0)

# Next, define a function to calculate the DHWs; this function takes 84-day sliding windows, sums the hotspot, and then divides by 7
calculate_dhw <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  result <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 84:n) {
    sum_hotspot <- sum(x[(i - 84 + 1):i],
                       na.rm = TRUE)
    result[i] <- ifelse(sum_hotspot >= 1,
                        sum_hotspot / 7,
                        0)
  }
  return(result)
}

# Apply function to data set
bwsdaymean$DHW <- calculate_dhw(bwsdaymean$Hotspot)
```

```{r}

             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2023-08-29"),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-04-27"),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 11), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 11)) +
  scale_x_date(expression(Year),
               limits = c(as.Date("2005-01-01"),
                          as.Date("2025-01-01"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expression(DHW),
                     limits = c(0,
                                16),
                     breaks = seq(0,
                                  16,
                                  4),
                     expand = c(0,
                                0))
```

#### Plot: DHWs

##### Calcuate DHWs

```{r}
# Calculate "hotspot" for each day; this is the temperature above the bleaching threshold (MMM + 1°C)
sitedaymean$Hotspot <- ifelse(sitedaymean$Temperature_C > 29.46,
                              sitedaymean$Temperature_C-29.46,
                              0)

# Next, define a function to calculate the DHWs; this function takes 84-day sliding windows, sums the hotspot, and then divides by 7
calculate_dhw <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  result <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 84:n) {
    sum_hotspot <- sum(x[(i - 84 + 1):i],
                       na.rm = TRUE)
    result[i] <- ifelse(sum_hotspot >= 1,
                        sum_hotspot / 7,
                        0)
  }
  return(result)
}

# Apply function to data set for each site
## CI
sitedaymeanCI <- subset(sitedaymean,
                        Site == "Cristobal Island")
sitedaymeanCI$DHW <- calculate_dhw(sitedaymeanCI$Hotspot)

## HP
sitedaymeanHP <- subset(sitedaymean,
                        Site == "Hospital Point")
sitedaymeanHP$DHW <- calculate_dhw(sitedaymeanHP$Hotspot)

## PD
sitedaymeanPD <- subset(sitedaymean,
                        Site == "Punta Donato")
sitedaymeanPD$DHW <- calculate_dhw(sitedaymeanPD$Hotspot)

## SP
sitedaymeanSP <- subset(sitedaymean,
                        Site == "STRI Point")
sitedaymeanSP$DHW <- calculate_dhw(sitedaymeanSP$Hotspot)

# Bind all
sitedaymeanDHW <- rbind(sitedaymeanCI,
                        sitedaymeanHP,
                        sitedaymeanPD,
                        sitedaymeanSP)
```

# Health status

## Upload data

```{r}
# Read CSV
healthdata <- read.csv("Health_status_data.csv",
                       header = T)
```

## Bleaching status by site over time

### Make data

```{r}
# Make empty data frame to store data
statusdf <- data.frame(Site = factor(),
                       Year = factor(),
                       Bleaching_status = factor(),
                       Proportion = numeric())

# Loop through and make proportions
for (site in unique(healthdata$Site)) {
  for (year in unique(healthdata$Year)) {
    healthsub <- subset(healthdata,
                        Site == site &
                          Year == year)
    coralnum <- nrow(healthsub)
    for (status in unique(healthdata$Bleaching_status)) {
      healthsubstat <- subset(healthsub,
                              Bleaching_status == status)
      numwithstat <- nrow(healthsubstat)
      propwithstat <- numwithstat/coralnum
      statusdf <- rbind(statusdf,
                         data.frame(Site = site,
                                    Year = year,
                                    Bleaching_status = status,
                                    Proportion = propwithstat))
    }
  }
}

# Set factor order
statusdf$Bleaching_status <- factor(statusdf$Bleaching_status,
                                 levels = c("Pigmented",
                                            "Partially bleached",
                                            "Fully bleached"))
```

### Plot: bleaching status

#### Make plot

```{r}
# Make plot
```

### Plot: mortality

#### Add bleached in 2023

```{r}
# Get list of corals with status in 2023
corals2023 <- unique(subset(healthdata,
                            Year == 2023)$Coral_ID)

# Add status column
healthdata$Status_in_2023 <- NA

# Loop through and add status
for (i in 1:nrow(healthdata)) {
  if (healthdata$Coral_ID[i] %in% corals2023) {
    stat2023 <- subset(healthdata,
                       Coral_ID == healthdata$Coral_ID[i] &
                         Year == 2023)$Bleaching_status
    if (stat2023 == "Pigmented") {
      healthdata$Status_in_2023[i] <- "No"
    }
    else {
      healthdata$Status_in_2023[i] <- "Yes"
    }
  }
}

# Summarize
mortdata <- summarySE(data = healthdata,
                      groupvars = c("Year",
                                    "Site",
                                    "Status_in_2023"),
                      measurevar = "Percent_mortality_since_2022")
```

#### Statistical analysis

```{r}
# Linear model
mortmod <- lmer(Percent_mortality_since_2022 ~ factor(Year)*Site*Status_in_2023 + (1|Coral_ID),
                data = subset(healthdata,
                              !is.na(Status_in_2023)))

# ANOVA
mortaov <- Anova(mortmod,
                 type = "III")
mortaov

# EMMeans
mortemmeans <- emmeans(mortmod,
                       ~ factor(Year):Site:Status_in_2023)

# Tukey
mortTukey <- contrast(mortemmeans,
                      method = "pairwise",
                      simple = "Status_in_2023")
mortTukey
```


#### Make plot


## Disease status by site over time

### Make data

```{r}
# Make empty data frame to store data
diseasedf <- data.frame(Site = factor(),
                        Year = factor(),
                        Disease_status = factor(),
                        Proportion = numeric())

# Loop through and make proportions
for (site in unique(healthdata$Site)) {
  for (year in unique(healthdata$Year)) {
    healthsub <- subset(healthdata,
                        Site == site &
                          Year == year)
    coralnum <- nrow(healthsub)
    for (status in unique(healthdata$Signs_of_disease)) {
      healthsubstat <- subset(healthsub,
                              Signs_of_disease == status)
      numwithstat <- nrow(healthsubstat)
      propwithstat <- numwithstat/coralnum
      diseasedf <- rbind(diseasedf,
                         data.frame(Site = site,
                                    Year = year,
                                    Disease_status = status,
                                    Proportion = propwithstat))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
postMEDpermaov
```

### Bar plot of genus by site and year

#### Make longer data

```{r}
# Make longer data
postMEDdatal <- pivot_longer(data = postMEDdata,
                             cols = !c("Sample_ID",
                                      "Year",
                                      "Coral_ID",
                                      "Site",
                                      "Lineage",
                                      "Depth_m"),
                             names_to = "Sequence",
                             values_to = "Relative_abundance")
postMEDdatal <- data.frame(subset(postMEDdatal,
                                  Relative_abundance != 0))

# Add column for genus
postMEDdatal$Genus <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(postMEDdatal)) {
  if (startsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "A") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Symbiodinium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "A") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Symbiodinium"
  }
  else if (startsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "B") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Breviolum"
  }
  else if (endsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "B") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Breviolum"
  }
  else if (startsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "C") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Cladocopium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "C") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Cladocopium"
  }
  else if (startsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "D") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Durusdinium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(postMEDdatal$Sequence[i], "D") == TRUE) {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "Durusdinium"
  }
  else {
    postMEDdatal$Genus[i] <- "NA"
  }
}

# Sum by genus for each coral
postMEDdatalsum <- summarise(.data = postMEDdatal,
                             .by = c(Sample_ID,
                                     Year,
                                     Coral_ID,
                                     Site,
                                     Lineage,
                                     Depth_m,
                                     Genus),
                             Relative_abundance = sum(Relative_abundance))
```

## Relating symbiont community shifts to mortality

### Make community shift data

```{r}
# Make empty data frame to store data
commshiftdf <- data.frame(Coral_ID = factor(),
                          Year = numeric(),
                          Community_change = numeric())

for (ID in unique(postMEDdatalsumall3$Coral_ID)) {
  postMEDdfID <- subset(postMEDdatalsumall3,
                        Coral_ID == ID)
  B22df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Breviolum" &
                  Year == 2022)
  if (nrow(B22df) != 0) {
    B22 <- B22df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    B22 <- 0
  }
  C22df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Cladocopium" &
                  Year == 2022)
  if (nrow(C22df) != 0) {
    C22 <- C22df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    C22 <- 0
  }
  D22df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Durusdinium" &
                  Year == 2022)
  if (nrow(D22df) != 0) {
    D22 <- D22df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    D22 <- 0
  }
  B23df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Breviolum" &
                  Year == 2023)
  if (nrow(B23df) != 0) {
    B23 <- B23df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    B23 <- 0
  }
  C23df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                 Genus == "Cladocopium" &
                  Year == 2023)
  if (nrow(C23df) != 0) {
    C23 <- C23df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    C23 <- 0
  }
  D23df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Durusdinium" &
                  Year == 2023)
  if (nrow(D23df) != 0) {
    D23 <- D23df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    D23 <- 0
  }
  B24df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                 Genus == "Breviolum" &
                 Year == 2024)
  if (nrow(B24df) != 0) {
    B24 <- B24df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    B24 <- 0
  }
  C24df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Cladocopium" &
                  Year == 2024)
  if (nrow(C24df) != 0) {
    C24 <- C24df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    C24 <- 0
  }
  D24df <- subset(postMEDdfID,
                  Genus == "Durusdinium" &
                  Year == 2024)
  if (nrow(D24df) != 0) {
    D24 <- D24df$Relative_abundance
  }
  else {
    D24 <- 0
  }
  dist2322 <- sqrt((B23 - B22)^2 + (C23 - C22)^2 + (D23 - D22)^2)
  dist2422 <- sqrt((B24 - B22)^2 + (C24 - C22)^2 + (D24 - D22)^2)
  commshiftdf <- rbind(commshiftdf,
                       data.frame(Coral_ID = ID,
                                  Year = 2023,
                                  Community_change_since_2022 = dist2322))
  commshiftdf <- rbind(commshiftdf,
                       data.frame(Coral_ID = ID,
                                  Year = 2024,
                                  Community_change_since_2022 = dist2422))
}
```

### Combine with mortality data

```{r}
commshiftdf$Percent_mortality_since_2022 <- NA
commshiftdf$Site <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(commshiftdf)) {
  IDformort <- commshiftdf$Coral_ID[i]
  yearformort <- commshiftdf$Year[i] 
  mortdf <- subset(healthdata,
                   Coral_ID == IDformort & 
                     Year == yearformort)
  if (nrow(mortdf) != 0) {
    commshiftdf$Percent_mortality_since_2022[i] <- mortdf$Percent_mortality_since_2022
    commshiftdf$Site[i] <- mortdf$Site
  }
}
```

```{r}
                                   size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 11),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
```

```{r}
shanTukey
```

# 16S

## Upload data

```{r}
# ASV table
ASVtab <- readRDS("seqtab_nochim.rds")

# Taxa table
taxtab <- readRDS("taxa.rds")

# Sample metadata
meta16S <- read.csv("16S_metadata.csv",
                    header = T)

# Get sample names
sample_names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(meta16S$R1_file_full),
                                "_16S_R1.fastq"),
                       `[`,
                       1)

# Sort metadata by sample names in ASV table
meta16Ssort <- meta16S
meta16Ssort$Sample_names <- sample_names
meta16Ssort <- meta16Ssort[match(trimws(rownames(ASVtab)),
                                 meta16Ssort$Sample_names), ]

# Take desired columns for phyloseq
meta16Sphylo <- meta16Ssort[,c("Coral_ID",
                               "Year",
                               "Site",
                               "Lineage",
                               "Depth_m")]
rownames(meta16Sphylo) <- rownames(ASVtab)
meta16Sphylo$Year <- as.factor(meta16Sphylo$Year)
```

## Make base phyloseq object

```{r}
# Make
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(ASVtab,
                         taxa_are_rows = FALSE), 
               sample_data(meta16Sphylo), 
               tax_table(taxtab))

# Save sequences separately
ASVseqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps))
names(ASVseqs) <- taxa_names(ps)
ps <- merge_phyloseq(ps,
                     ASVseqs)
taxa_names(ps) <- paste0("ASV",
                         seq(ntaxa(ps)))
ps@sam_data$Sample_ID <- sample_names(ps)

# Remove NCs and coral 66 from 2023 (no reads)
ps <- subset_samples(ps,
                     is.na(Site) == F &
                       Sample_ID != " 66_F7")

# Remove taxa with no reads
ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0,
                 ps)

# Remove eukaryotes and reads from chloroplasts/mitochondria
ps <- subset_taxa(ps,
                  Kingdom != "Eukaryota")
ps <- subset_taxa(ps,
                  Order != "Chloroplast")
ps <- subset_taxa(ps,
                  Family != "Mitochondria")
```

## Make base for corals with data over all 3 years

```{r}
# List of corals with data for all 3 years
all3list16S <- c()
for (ID in unique(meta16Sphylo$Coral_ID)) {
  if (length(unique((subset(meta16Sphylo,
                            Coral_ID == ID))$Year)) == 3 &
      ID != "66") {
    all3list16S <- c(all3list16S,
                     ID)
  }
}

# Prune samples
psall3 <- prune_samples(ps@sam_data$Coral_ID %in% all3list16S,
                        ps)
```

## Relative abundance

### Make data

```{r}
# Create relative abundance objects
psrel <- transform_sample_counts(ps,
                                 function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))
psrelall3 <- transform_sample_counts(psall3,
                                     function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r}
# Get distance matrix
psreldist <- distance(psrel,
                      method = "bray")

# Get sample data df
psrelsamdata <- data.frame(sample_data(psrel))

# Run PERMANOVA
permAOV16Srel <- adonis2(psreldist ~ Year*Site*Lineage*Depth_m,
                         data = psrelsamdata)
permAOV16Srel
```

## Filter for abundant taxa

### Make data

```{r}
# Set thresholds (min_abund*100 % abundance in at least min_samples samples)
min_abund <- 0.05
min_samples <- 5

# Get taxa
keep_taxa <- apply(otu_table(psrelall3),
                   2,
                   function(x) {
                     sum(x >= min_abund) >= min_samples
                     })

# Prune
psrelall3maj <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa,
                           psrelall3)

# Melt for ggplot
psrelall3majdf <- psmelt(psrelall3maj)
```

## Shannon index

### Make data

```{r}
# Make data
shannon_data <- estimate_richness(psall3,
                                  measures = c("Shannon"))

# Add metadata
shannon_data <- cbind(shannon_data,
                      subset(meta16Sphylo,
                             Coral_ID %in% all3list16S))
```

### Statistics

```{r}
# Linear model
shanlm16S <- lm(Shannon ~ factor(Year)*Site,
                data = shannon_data)

# ANOVA
shanaov16S <- Anova(shanlm16S,
                    type = "III")
shanaov16S

# EMMeans
shanemmeans16S <- emmeans(shanlm16S,
                          ~ factor(Year):Site)

# Tukey
shanTukey16S <- contrast(shanemmeans16S,
                         method = "pairwise",
                         simple = "Year")
shanTukey16S
```


### Plot

#### Make plot

```{r}
                        aes(x = factor(Year),
```

# Community similarity (ITS2 and 16S together)

## Make data

```{r}
# Get list of corals with both ITS2 and 16S data for all 3 years
all3listboth <- intersect(all3list,
                          all3list16S)

# Subset data
all3bITS2 <- subset(postMEDabsdata,
                    Coral_ID %in% all3listboth)
all3b16S <- prune_samples(ps@sam_data$Coral_ID %in% all3listboth,
                          ps)
all3b16Sdf <- data.frame(cbind(sample_data(all3b16S),
                               otu_table(all3b16S)))

# Ensure same order
rownames(all3bITS2) <- NULL
rownames(all3b16Sdf) <- NULL
all3bITS2$Coral_Year <- paste0(all3bITS2$Coral_ID,
                               "_",
                               all3bITS2$Year)
all3b16Sdf$Coral_Year <- paste0(all3b16Sdf$Coral_ID,
                                "_",
                                all3b16Sdf$Year)
all3bITS2 <- all3bITS2[match(all3b16Sdf$Coral_Year,
                             all3bITS2$Coral_Year), ]

# Remove metadata
rownames(all3bITS2) <- NULL
rownames(all3b16Sdf) <- NULL
metasave <- all3bITS2[,c(1:6)]
all3bITS2 <- all3bITS2[,-c(1:6,
                           727)]
all3b16Sdf <- all3b16Sdf[,-c(1:6,
                             25741)]

# Remove sequences that do not appear in any sample
all3bITS2[colSums(all3bITS2) != 0]
all3b16Sdf[colSums(all3b16Sdf) != 0]

# Bind together with metadata
all3bothdf <- cbind(metasave,
                    all3bITS2,
                    all3b16Sdf)
```

## Similarity testing

```{r}
# Make distance matrix
all3bothdist <- vegdist(all3bothdf[,7:26460],
                        "bray")

# Test for difference in beta dispersion by Site*Year
betadisres <- betadisper(all3bothdist,
                         group = interaction(all3bothdf$Site,
                                             all3bothdf$Year))
betadistest <- permutest(betadisres,
                         permutations = 999)
## p < 0.001, conclude that groups do NOT have the same beta dispersion

# Test for difference in centroids
anosimres <- anosim(all3bothdist,
                    grouping = interaction(all3bothdf$Site,
                                           all3bothdf$Year))
summary(anosimres)
# p < 0.001, conclude that groups do NOT have the same centroid

# Do PCoA
all3bothPCoA <- cmdscale(all3bothdist,
                         eig = T,
                         add = T)

# Calculate percent explained
all3bothpctexp <- (all3bothPCoA$eig/sum(all3bothPCoA$eig))*100

# Add PCoAs to data frame
all3bothPCoAdf <- all3bothdf
all3bothPCoAdf$PCo1 <- all3bothPCoA$points[,1]
all3bothPCoAdf$PCo2 <- all3bothPCoA$points[,2]
```

# Networks

## By site and year

### Make data

```{r}
# Plan here is to make a new phyloseq object using the "all3bothdf" which has metadata and absolute abundances for all ITS2 and 16S sequences
## Need: OTU table, sample data, and taxonomy table
### The sample data is all3bothdf[,1:6]
### The OTU table is all3bothdf[,7:26460]
### Taxonomy table for 16S --> get from all3b16S phyloseq object (was used to make 16S portion of all3bothdf)
### Taxonomy table for ITS2 --> make here, colnames are classification and rownames we can take from all3bothdf

## Make taxonomy table for ITS2
ITS2taxtab <- data.frame("Kingdom" = rep("Eukaryota",
                                         ncol(all3bITS2)),
                         "Phylum" = rep("Dinoflagellata",
                                        ncol(all3bITS2)),
                         "Class" = rep("Dinophyceae",
                                       ncol(all3bITS2)),
                         "Order" = rep("Suessiales",
                                       ncol(all3bITS2)),
                         "Family" = rep("Symbiodiniaceae",
                                        ncol(all3bITS2)),
                         "Genus" = NA,
                         "Species" = NA)
rownames(ITS2taxtab) <- colnames(all3bITS2)

for (i in 1:nrow(ITS2taxtab)) {
  if (startsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "A") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Symbiodinium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "A") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Symbiodinium"
  }
  else if (startsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "B") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Breviolum"
  }
  else if (endsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "B") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Breviolum"
  }
  else if (startsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "C") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Cladocopium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "C") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Cladocopium"
  }
  else if (startsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "D") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Durusdinium"
  }
  else if (endsWith(rownames(ITS2taxtab)[i], "D") == TRUE) {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "Durusdinium"
  }
  else {
    ITS2taxtab$Genus[i] <- "NA"
  }
}

# Make joint taxonomy table
taxtab16S <- data.frame(tax_table(all3b16S))
taxtabboth <- rbind(ITS2taxtab,
                    taxtab16S)

# Make phyloseq object
psfornet <- phyloseq(otu_table(as.matrix(all3bothdf[,7:26460]),
                               taxa_are_rows = FALSE), 
                     sample_data(all3bothdf[,1:6]), 
                     tax_table(as.matrix(taxtabboth)))
psfornet <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psfornet) > 0,
                       psfornet)

# Add color to OTU table
taxnet <- data.frame(tax_table(psfornet))
taxnet$Color <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(taxnet)) {
  if (taxnet$Family[i] == "Symbiodiniaceae") {
    taxnet$Color[i] <- "Sym"
  }
  else {
    taxnet$Color[i] <- "ASV"
  }
}
tax_table(psfornet) <- as.matrix(taxnet)
```

```{r}
CI22net <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(CI22net) > 0,
                      CI22net)
keepCI22 <- apply(otu_table(CI22net),
```

```{r}
keepHP22 <- apply(otu_table(HP22net),
                  2,
                  function(x) {
                    sum(x >= 5) >= 2
                    })
HP22net <- prune_taxa(keepHP22,
                      HP22net)
```

#### Plot

##### Make plot

```{r}
# Make plot
HP22netplot <- plot_net(HP22net,
                        type = "taxa",
                        maxdist = 0.4,
                        color = "Color",
                        point_size = 0.01) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,
                        0,
                        0,
                        0),
                        "in"))  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sym" = "#D59E87",
                                "ASV" = "#87AE52"))
```

##### Visualize and save plot

```{r}
# Visualize plot
HP22netplot

# Save plot
ggsave("HP22 network plot.pdf",
       width = 1.2,
       height = 1.2,
       units = "in")
```

## Network quantitative analysis (number of nodes and edges)

### Make data

```{r}
# Extract data from graph objects
allnetdata <- data.frame(Site = character(),
                         Year = numeric(),
                         Nodes = numeric(),
                         Edges = numeric())
allnetdata[1,] <- c("Cristobal Island",
                    2022,
                    length(unique(c(CI22netplot$data$v1,
                                    CI22netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(CI22netplot$data))
allnetdata[2,] <- c("Cristobal Island",
                    2023,
                    length(unique(c(CI23netplot$data$v1,
                                    CI23netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(CI23netplot$data))
allnetdata[3,] <- c("Cristobal Island",
                    2024,
                    length(unique(c(CI24netplot$data$v1,
                                    CI24netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(CI24netplot$data))
allnetdata[4,] <- c("Hospital Point",
                    2022,
                    length(unique(c(HP22netplot$data$v1,
                                    HP22netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(HP22netplot$data))
allnetdata[5,] <- c("Hospital Point",
                    2023,
                    length(unique(c(HP23netplot$data$v1,
                                    HP23netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(HP23netplot$data))
allnetdata[6,] <- c("Hospital Point",
                    2024,
                    length(unique(c(HP24netplot$data$v1,
                                    HP24netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(HP24netplot$data))
allnetdata[7,] <- c("Punta Donato",
                    2022,
                    length(unique(c(PD22netplot$data$v1,
                                    PD22netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(PD22netplot$data))
allnetdata[8,] <- c("Punta Donato",
                    2023,
                    length(unique(c(PD23netplot$data$v1,
                                    PD23netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(PD23netplot$data))
allnetdata[9,] <- c("Punta Donato",
                    2024,
                    length(unique(c(PD24netplot$data$v1,
                                    PD24netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(PD24netplot$data))
allnetdata[10,] <- c("STRI Point",
                    2022,
                    length(unique(c(SP22netplot$data$v1,
                                    SP22netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(SP22netplot$data))
allnetdata[11,] <- c("STRI Point",
                    2023,
                    length(unique(c(SP23netplot$data$v1,
                                    SP23netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(SP23netplot$data))
allnetdata[12,] <- c("STRI Point",
                    2024,
                    length(unique(c(SP24netplot$data$v1,
                                    SP24netplot$data$v2))),
                    nrow(SP24netplot$data))
allnetdatag <- gather(allnetdata,
                      key = "Feature",
                      value = "Count",
                      -c(1:2))
allnetdatag$Count <- as.numeric(allnetdatag$Count)
```

### Plot

#### Make plot

```{r}
# Make plot
netconplot <- ggplot(data = allnetdatag,
                     aes(x = as.factor(Year),
                         y = Count)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site,
             nrow = 1) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           aes(fill = Feature),
           position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 11), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black",
                                     size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 11),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 11)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Count") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Edges" = "darkgray",
                               "Nodes" = "lightgray"))
```

#### Visualize and save plot

```{r}
# Visualize plot
netconplot

# Save plot
ggsave("Network features plot.pdf",
       width = 6,
       height = 3,
       units = "in")
```
